title: Concept: Pubspec that overrides a dependency
description: pubspec.yaml declares a `dependency_overrides` entry that replaces the declared constraint, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `dependency_overrides` entry that replaces the declared constraint.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `dependency_overrides` entry that replaces the declared constraint.
